# WESTOURS (西境行)

> WESTOURS (西境行) is a boutique inbound travel company specializing in private, tailor-made Western China tours for international travelers. We design private journeys across Tibet, Xinjiang, Sichuan & Chengdu, Yunnan, Qinghai, and Gansu & the Silk Road, with English-speaking support, local guides, and full on-the-ground logistics.

WESTOURS focuses exclusively on Western China and serves English-speaking travelers from North America, Europe, Australia, Singapore and other international markets. Every itinerary is private and tailor-made. The company is not a mass-market tour operator and does not sell fixed group packages.

## Who it is for
- Culture-focused travelers, adventure travelers, photographers
- Small-group and premium private tour clients
- Retired travelers interested in China
- Travelers who want to see China beyond Beijing, Shanghai and the usual tourist routes

## Destinations
- [Destinations overview](https://www.westours.cn/destinations/): All Western China regions.
- [Tibet](https://www.westours.cn/destinations/tibet/): Lhasa, Potala Palace, Yamdrok Lake, the plateau; permits and guides arranged.
- [Xinjiang](https://www.westours.cn/destinations/xinjiang/): Kashgar, Karakul Lake, the Pamir, Turpan, Silk Road oasis towns and deserts.
- [Sichuan & Chengdu](https://www.westours.cn/destinations/sichuan-chengdu/): Chengdu food and teahouses, Mount Emei, the Tibetan edge of western Sichuan.
- [Yunnan](https://www.westours.cn/destinations/yunnan/): Dali, Lijiang, Shangri-La, rice terraces, ethnic villages.
- [Qinghai](https://www.westours.cn/destinations/qinghai/): Qinghai Lake, grasslands, Tibetan monasteries, plateau road trips.
- [Gansu & Silk Road](https://www.westours.cn/destinations/gansu-silk-road/): Dunhuang Mogao Caves, Zhangye Danxia, Jiayuguan, the Hexi Corridor.
